title: devcontainer-kit per-repository config (.devcontainer/dck.toml), interface 2
description: TOML document, described here as its JSON equivalent. Unknown keys are ignored with a warning.

interface.description: 2; a version-1 file is read for migration only (dck init rewrites it)

service.description: Compose service the tools attach to

image_tag.description: interface 1 only: ignored since v0.2.0 (no shared base image); dck init removes it

ssh_port.description: Loopback-only host port for the container sshd (Herdr); 0 = no sshd

bind.description: Host address every published port binds to

agents.description: Install coding-agents-kit (ak) at its pinned tag

dailybot.description: Install the Dailybot CLI (only when the dailybot addon asks for it)

editor.description: nvim + deepworkplan-vim as the default editor

clis.description: Kinds passed to `ak install` when layers.agents is true

machine.description: Register the container as a Herdr machine on `dck up` (needs ssh_port)

layout.description: the Herdr sidebar dck up creates inside the container

mesh.description: dck up runs dck herdr mesh (Docker Desktop only): agents inside reach the other dck containers and, with host_machine, the host

base_image.description: optional: an official image for the runtime, pinned by digest; defaults to the flavour's pin in versions.env

ssh_agent.description: share the host's SSH agent with the container (git over SSH; keys never enter it)
